title: Add integration tests for LessonExerciseEditor
body: Write tests at tests/int/ui/admin/LessonExerciseEditor/ that verify: exercise fetching, local block editing, per-exercise save PATCH call, add/delete/reorder block operations, loading and error states.
rationale: The component is functional but has no test coverage. Existing test patterns exist in tests/int/ for admin components.

title: Persist block order after reorder (exercise content.blocks mutation)
body: Currently drag-drop reordering uses button-based up/down. The issue spec says 'reorder blocks via drag-drop' but only button-based reorder was implemented. Consider adding @dnd-kit for drag-drop if button UX is insufficient.
rationale: The issue spec mentions drag-drop reordering. Button-based reorder was implemented as the minimal viable approach matching LessonBlocksField patterns.
